newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes up but Komercni fall-back seen.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes up but Komercni fall-back seen.

text.p: Gains to Czech major issues during continuous trading pushed the PX50 index higher on Wednesday but dealers cautioned that one of the biggest risers, Komercni Banka, may fall back in future sessions.
The PX50 rose 2.5 points, 0.45 percent, to 560.7 while the RPIX index closed up 8.3 points, 0.71 percent, to 1,174.8.
Komercni rose 50 crowns, more than two percent, to 2,450 but turnover during continuous trading was low and buying was said by dealers to be sporadic.
"I expect it should start to go lower. It looks expensive at this level," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
Kusacek said some small early orders for Komercni, probably involving around 10,000 shares, had been responsible for the issue's initial surge.
But he added that subsequent interest at that price had failed to materialise indicating that it was likely to fall. On the over-the-counter market Komercni was trading at around 2,430/2,455.
Among other major issues, SPT Telecom bounced back from early declines to close up 10 crowns at 3,400. CEZ lost one crown to 1,074 and Ceska Sporitelna rose three crowns to 320.
